_doc: Entity-scope regression fixture. The Account Cartographer must not conflate a subsidiary executive with the parent group's apex. Anchor case: 'Al Tayer Group' is a family-/chair-led conglomerate with NO group CEO — its apex is Executive Chairman Obeid Al Tayer. Dee Sarai is CEO of Al Tayer Insignia (a subsidiary/brand) and must be stored with entityScope='subsidiary' + entityName='Al Tayer Insignia', NEVER as the group CEO. The deterministic guard (guardCartographerEntityScope) enforces this regardless of model variance; see tests/cartographer-guard/run.ts. Live web_search output is non-deterministic, so these asserts encode the corrected target shape rather than exact prose.
